content: Petrus tee Kornelius
I kota Kaisarea dhaangia samia mokosaroakana Kornelius, samia kapitana Roma to mokapalaina saangu batalion tantara isarongiaka "Batalion Italia."
Incia satotuuna samia suludadu mosaalihi tee bhari-bharia miana bhanuana amaeka tee Aulataʼala. Incia uka abhari adhawu sadakaa i miana Yahudi momisikini tee sadia adoʼa i Aulataʼala.

Saangu wakutuu kera-kera rambi talu mata konowia, incia apotibhaaka saangu pokamata. I nuncana pokamatana sumai, incia atinda mpuu akamata malaaʼekatina Aulataʼala aumba apokawaakea tee apogau, "Kornelius!"
Tee kaekana incia atonto malaaʼekati sumai tee apogau, "Tuaapa Opu?" Malaaʼekati sumai apogau, "Manga doʼamu tee sadakaamu i mia momisikini atarimaia Aulataʼala tee Incia audhaniko.
Sii-sii tumpumo mia alingka i Yope to akemba mia mokosaroakana Simon, isarongiaka uka Petrus.
Incia amboore i bhanuana mia mokosarona Simon, samia pande karajaana kulina binata. Bhanuana i bhiwina tawo."
Salingkana malaaʼekati mopogauna tee incia sumai, Kornelius akembamo rua mia bhatuana tee samia suludaduna mosaalihi, siitumo suludaduna karona mopobhawana torosu tee incia.
Kornelius apetulatulaakea bhari-bharia to manga incia, kasiimpo atumpua alingka i Yope.
Samainawana, wakutuuna talu miaia o mia ilambokona sumai dhaangiapo i dhala tee amakasumo tee kota sumai, kera-kera rambi sapulu rua mata pontanga eo, Petrus akompamo i bhawona bhanua to adoʼa.
Kasiimpo incia anamisi kaara tee gauna akande. Tangasaana o mia apasiapuaka kinande, saanampuu incia apotibhaakamo saangu pokamata mboomo i nuncana pongipi.
Incia akamata laiana atobungkale, kasiimpo dhaangia satumpo kae momaewa akaloe-loe i pataangua tapana tee apasapoa i tana.
I nuncana kae sumai adhaangia tee abhari mpuu giuna binata pata mbaliana aena, binata mopondele, tee manga manu-manu.
Kasiimpo atorangomo suara mopogauna, "Petrus, bhangumo! Sumbelemea tee ukandemea!"
Maka o Petrus apogau, "Kumendeu Kawasana Opu. Saʼumurua dhadhiku, indapo uka kukande o kinande moharamu tee monaajisi."
Suara sumai apendua uka apogau, "Opea ihalalaakana Aulataʼala bholi uharamuakea."
Suara incia sumai apendua uka atorango sakawana talu mpearo, kasiimpo kae sumai alausaka atoangka i laiana.

Petrus apekaabha-abha i nuncana ngangarandana opea o maʼanana pokamatana sumai. Wakutuu incia sumai o mia talu miana ilambokona Kornelius to apeelo bhanuana Simon, akabhale-bhalemo i aroana bhambana lawana bhanua sumai.
Manga incia akemba mia tee aabha, "Dhaangia o mia mokosaroakana Simon momboorena iwe sumai?"
Wakutuuna Petrus dhaangiapo atorotorosu aʼusaha to amatauaka opea o maʼanana pokamatana sumai, Rohina Aulataʼala apogau tee incia, "Dhaangia talu mia mopeeloko.
Makanumo tee usapomo. Lingkamo upobhawa tee manga incia, bholi umeri roonamo Iaku motumpua aumba iwe sii."
Sabutuna o Petrus asapomo to apokawaaka mia talu miana sumai tee apogau, "Iakumo ipeelomiu. Opea o haejatimiu uumba iwe sii?"

Manga incia alawani, "Kornelius, samia kapitana Roma, mia momakatena incana tee amaeka tee Aulataʼala, tee ahoromatia bhari-bharia miana Yahudi. Incia atumpua malaaʼekatina Aulataʼala to taumba takembako to uumba i bhanuana mamudhaakana aperangoi opea ipogauakamu."

Sumaimo o Petrus akemba manga mia ilambokona Kornelius sumai apesua tee apomalo iwe sumai. Samainawana o Petrus abhangumo tee alingka apobhawa tee manga mia incia sumai. Dhaangia uka pia mia moparacaeana tee Isa mominaakana i Yope moosena manga incia.
Saeo sapadhana incia sumai manga incia akawamo i Kota Kaisarea. Tee manga incia aantagia Kornelius, bhari-bharia witinai tee musiraha momakasuna uka akembaia to aporomusaka i bhanuana.
Wakutuuna Petrus siimpo aumba i nuncana bhanua sumai, Kornelius apepagoa tee asuju i aroana.
Maka o Petrus apakakaroa tee apogau, "Kakaromo, iaku sii tangkanamo maanusia."
Tangaasana apogau tee Kornelius, Petrus apesua tee apokawaaka mia bhari moporomusakana iwe sumai.

Petrus apogau, "Ingkomiu umataua karomiu ande o miana Yahudi aharamu aposabhangka atawa aleongi bhanuana mia inda motolentuna miana Yahudi. Maka o Aulataʼala padhamo asusuakaaku ande inda kumembali kusarongi mia akaafiri atawa anaajisi.
Rampaakanamo sumai, wakutuuna kutokemba iwe sii, iaku inda kupealai. Sii-sii iaku kuabha tee ingkoo, opea o haejatimu to ukembaaku?"

Kornelius alawani, "Pata eo molapana, i wakutuu mopokanana mboomo sii-sii, siitumo rambi talu mata konowia, iaku tangasaana kudoʼa i bhanua. Saanampuu dhaangia o mia mokabhale-bhalena i aroaku. Mia sumai apake bhaju mokakila-kila,
kasiimpo apogau, 'Kornelius, doʼamu arangomea tee o sadakaamu audhania Aulataʼala.
Sababuna sumai, utumpumo mia alingka i Yope to akemba Simon. Incia tangasaana abutu i bhanuana Simon samia pande karajaana kulina binata. Bhanuana i bhiwina tawo.'

Sabutuna kulausakamo kulamboko mia to mokembako, tee ingkoo uumba tee ngangaranda momasanaa. Sii-sii bhari-bharikami dhaangiamo iwe sii i aroana Aulataʼala, mamudhaakana taperangoi bhari-bharia iparintaakana Kawasana Opu to ingkoo tee upakawaakea to ingkami."
Manga Mia Inda Mopesuana i Miana Yahudi Arango Lele Malape
Kasiimpo Petrus apepuumo apogau, "Sii-sii kutotuu-totuu kumataua, ande o Aulataʼala inda apaposala-sala mia.
Minaaka i lipu iapaipo, ande amaeka tee Aulataʼala tee akarajaa giu mobanara, Aulataʼala dhaanamo atarimaia.
Siimo o firimani ipakawaakana Aulataʼala to miana Israel, siitumo o firimani mopakoleleakana dhadhi pomalape tee Aulataʼala minaaka i Isa Al Masi Oputa Momalanga to bhari-bharia mia.
Ingkomiu umataua bhari-bharia momembalina i saangua tana Yudea (lipuna miana Israel), pepuu minaaka i Galilea sapadhana papebhahoa ipakoleleakana Nabii Yahya.

Ingkomiu uka umataua ande o Aulataʼala padhamo apili Isa miana Nazaret sumai, mopadhana iangkana Aulataʼala tee adhawuakea Rohina Aulataʼala tee kuasana. Tee ingkomiu umataua ande o Isa sumai alingka apekatii-tii iapai-iapai to apewau giu momalape tee apaunto kapiina bhari-bharia mia ikuasaina Ibilisi, roonamo Aulataʼala apobhawa tee Incia.
Ingkamimo o sakusii minaaka i bhari-bharia giu ipewauna i tana Yudea tee i Yerusalem. Manga inciamo mopekamatena Isa tee itoloeakana i kau salib.
Maka o Aulataʼala apadhadhia pendua talu eo sapadhana sumai, tee aundaakea o Isa apatiumba karona,

mencuana to bhari-bharia mia, maka tangkanamo to ingkami, manga sakusii mopadhana moporikanana ipilina Aulataʼala, siitumo ingkami mokandena tee mosumpuna mopobhawa tee Incia sabhanguna minaaka i mate.

Incia manga parintaaka to tapakoleleakea i bhari-bharia mia, tee tasakusiiakea ande Incia mopadhana iangkana Aulataʼala to amembali haakimu to bhari-bharia mia, malape o mia modhadhi atawa o mia momate.
Bhari-bharia nabii asakusiiakea, manga incia apogau, "Bhari-bharia mia moparacaeana tee Al Masi bheatoʼamponi o dosana alaloi sarona."
Manga Mia Inda Motolentuna Miana Yahudi Apotibhaaka Rohina Aulataʼala
Wakutuuna o Petrus tangasaana apogau, Rohina Aulataʼala asapo tee akuasai bhari-bharia mia morangona firimani sumai.
Bhari-bharia mia mominaakana i rombongana mia mototandaki,
siitumo moparacaeana tee Isa moumbana mopobhawana tee Petrus i bhanuana Kornelius amente akamata Aulataʼala adhawuaka Rohina to manga mia mominaakana i lipu mosagaanana uka,
roonamo manga incia arango manga mia sumai apogau i nuncana pogau inda momentela irahumatina Rohina Aulataʼala tee apuji kaogesana Aulataʼala. Kasiimpo Petrus apogau,
"Manga mia incia sii padhamo atarima Rohina Aulataʼala apokana tee ingkita. Jadi, dhaangia buaka o mia momembalina mojoli-jolina manga incia to atopapebhaho tee uwe?"

Kasiimpo Petrus atumpu manga incia to apapebhahoa to tandana ande manga incia amembalimo mia moosena Isa Al Masi. Kasiimpo manga incia aemani tee Petrus, "Ande amembali, umboorepo iwe sii pia eopo uka."
